about: Shows a short message to everybody signed in to the admin console, the user portal or the reports application, in a banner at the top of every tab of them open now. It is sent as this service's own Shared Signals event on each application's receiver stream, and a tab shows it within about {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}. The banner closes itself after ten seconds. A tab opened later does not show it.
